messages:
Maya R: Heads-up: Spectra RFI needs a POC runbook + traffic model + short ops FAQ. Deliverable by EOD Fri. Who owns the runbook?

Ethan L: I can draft. Need perf numbers and a clear KMS/HSM answer. Ravi, can you paste a 2-line traffic sketch?

Ravi P: From latest bench: ~110 QPS/node (8k context, tuned batching), p95 ~350ms. For their ask (15 rps steady, 2.5k tokens avg) quick calc:
```
baseline=3 nodes
steady_rps=15
burst=6x -> peak=90 rps
```
TL;DR: 3 nodes cover steady, autoscale to 6-8 for bursts. I'll upload CSV.

Nora (sec-bot): Security: customer-managed KMS supported in hosted clouds. HSM-backed keys require Dedicated/Private + contract addendum. Suggested RFI line: "KMS supported; HSM available in Dedicated/Private with SOW."

Ethan L: Good. Runbook will include oncall, escalation, node replacement steps, prefix-cache flush, sticky routing to dedicated pool, and a short exclusions list (no FedRAMP, no long-term HSM SLA in hosted POC).

Maya R: Also include a control-mapping table (control -> enforced-in). I'll assemble slides after draft. Meeting to review tomorrow 9am PT.

Ethan L: Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/spectra_runbook_v1 (private). CSV: https://s3.redwood.ai/bench/spectra_sample.csv

Maya R: Thanks — will review and send final RFI reply for signoff by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
